Good day! I took a liking to your works and would like to request a work of my Ultrawoman!

I'd like for the illustration to be a POV from below as if the viewer is under her as she defends the city, something like the image referenced here: https://x.com/ShexyoArt/status/2020935736594252057?s=20

 She does seem to notice there is someone under her and her attention is drawn to look down at the viewer. Her expression can either be that of confusion that someone is still in the city or a smug expression because she has already safely defended it. Any added water or debris on her from the battle or additional details are up to you. 

I would also appreciate it greatly if there was more emphasis added to her breasts and butt for this angle if at all possible! 

Thank you very much for your time and consideration!
